title: War
biggest_lesson: Breaking a card game into smaller functions makes the round flow easier to reason about.
next_step: Practice coordinating more state across multiple functions.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
biggest_lesson: A clear board representation and small helper functions make win-condition logic manageable.
next_step: Build a project with repeated state changes and more complex validation.

title: Roulette
biggest_lesson: Changing state must be recalculated and reassigned during every round that depends on it.
next_step: Coordinate multiple changing collections and turn loops in a larger card game.

title: Blackjack
biggest_lesson: Tracing deck, hand, and total values across cooperating functions clarifies when to mutate data and when to use a return value.
next_step: Learn persistent structured data through file handling and JSON.

title: Coding Learning Tracker
biggest_lesson: Structured data can move from terminal input through program logic into JSON and back while each module keeps a clear responsibility.
next_step: Apply persistence and modular design in a new Python project.
